v0.1.0 quick reference card: raylib · raymath · rlgl

rlgl: low-level OpenGL abstraction →

# Functions Declaration - Matrix operations


(rl-matrix-mode mode)                                                         # Choose the current matrix to be transformed


(rl-push-matrix)                                                              # Push the current matrix to stack


(rl-pop-matrix)                                                               # Pop latest inserted matrix from stack


(rl-load-identity)                                                            # Reset current matrix to identity matrix


(rl-translatef x y z)                                                         # Multiply the current matrix by a translation matrix


(rl-rotatef angle x y z)                                                      # Multiply the current matrix by a rotation matrix


(rl-scalef x y z)                                                             # Multiply the current matrix by a scaling matrix


(rl-mult-matrixf matf)                                                        # Multiply the current matrix by another matrix


(rl-frustum left right bottom top znear zfar)                                 # 


(rl-ortho left right bottom top znear zfar)                                   # 


(rl-viewport x y width height)                                                # Set the viewport area


(rl-set-clip-planes near-plane far-plane)                                     # Set clip planes distances


(rl-get-cull-distance-near) → number                                          # Get cull plane distance near


(rl-get-cull-distance-far) → number                                           # Get cull plane distance far




# Functions Declaration - Vertex level operations


(rl-begin mode)                                                               # Initialize drawing mode (how to organize vertex)


(rl-end)                                                                      # Finish vertex providing


(rl-vertex2i x y)                                                             # Define one vertex (position) - 2 int


(rl-vertex2f x y)                                                             # Define one vertex (position) - 2 float


(rl-vertex3f x y z)                                                           # Define one vertex (position) - 3 float


(rl-tex-coord2f x y)                                                          # Define one vertex (texture coordinate) - 2 float


(rl-normal3f x y z)                                                           # Define one vertex (normal) - 3 float


(rl-color4ub r g b a)                                                         # Define one vertex (color) - 4 byte


(rl-color3f x y z)                                                            # Define one vertex (color) - 3 float


(rl-color4f x y z w)                                                          # Define one vertex (color) - 4 float




# Vertex buffers state


(rl-enable-vertex-array vao-id) → bool                                        # Enable vertex array (VAO, if supported)


(rl-disable-vertex-array)                                                     # Disable vertex array (VAO, if supported)


(rl-enable-vertex-buffer id)                                                  # Enable vertex buffer (VBO)


(rl-disable-vertex-buffer)                                                    # Disable vertex buffer (VBO)


(rl-enable-vertex-buffer-element id)                                          # Enable vertex buffer element (VBO element)


(rl-disable-vertex-buffer-element)                                            # Disable vertex buffer element (VBO element)


(rl-enable-vertex-attribute index)                                            # Enable vertex attribute index


(rl-disable-vertex-attribute index)                                           # Disable vertex attribute index


(rl-enable-state-pointer)                                                     # excluded: rlgl keeps the client-array pointer after the call returns


(rl-disable-state-pointer)                                                    # excluded: declared only for OpenGL 1.1 builds; the desktop build uses OpenGL 3.3




# Textures state


(rl-active-texture-slot slot)                                                 # Select and active a texture slot


(rl-enable-texture id)                                                        # Enable texture


(rl-disable-texture)                                                          # Disable texture


(rl-enable-texture-cubemap id)                                                # Enable texture cubemap


(rl-disable-texture-cubemap)                                                  # Disable texture cubemap


(rl-texture-parameters id param value)                                        # Set texture parameters (filter, wrap)


(rl-cubemap-parameters id param value)                                        # Set cubemap parameters (filter, wrap)




# Shader state


(rl-enable-shader id)                                                         # Enable shader program


(rl-disable-shader)                                                           # Disable shader program




# Framebuffer state


(rl-enable-framebuffer id)                                                    # Enable render texture (fbo)


(rl-disable-framebuffer)                                                      # Disable render texture (fbo), return to default framebuffer


(rl-get-active-framebuffer) → number                                          # Get the currently active render texture (fbo), 0 for default framebuffer


(rl-active-draw-buffers count)                                                # Activate multiple draw color buffers


(rl-blit-framebuffer src-x src-y src-width src-height dst-x dst-y dst-width dst-height buffer-mask)  # Blit active framebuffer to main framebuffer


(rl-bind-framebuffer target framebuffer)                                      # Bind framebuffer (FBO)




# General render state


(rl-enable-color-blend)                                                       # Enable color blending


(rl-disable-color-blend)                                                      # Disable color blending


(rl-enable-depth-test)                                                        # Enable depth test


(rl-disable-depth-test)                                                       # Disable depth test


(rl-enable-depth-mask)                                                        # Enable depth write


(rl-disable-depth-mask)                                                       # Disable depth write


(rl-enable-backface-culling)                                                  # Enable backface culling


(rl-disable-backface-culling)                                                 # Disable backface culling


(rl-color-mask r g b a)                                                       # Color mask control


(rl-set-cull-face mode)                                                       # Set face culling mode


(rl-enable-scissor-test)                                                      # Enable scissor test


(rl-disable-scissor-test)                                                     # Disable scissor test


(rl-scissor x y width height)                                                 # Scissor test


(rl-enable-wire-mode)                                                         # Enable wire mode


(rl-enable-point-mode)                                                        # Enable point mode


(rl-disable-wire-mode)                                                        # Disable wire (and point) mode


(rl-set-line-width width)                                                     # Set the line drawing width


(rl-get-line-width) → number                                                  # Get the line drawing width


(rl-enable-smooth-lines)                                                      # Enable line aliasing


(rl-disable-smooth-lines)                                                     # Disable line aliasing


(rl-enable-stereo-render)                                                     # Enable stereo rendering


(rl-disable-stereo-render)                                                    # Disable stereo rendering


(rl-stereo-render-enabled?) → bool                                            # Check if stereo render is enabled


(rl-clear-color r g b a)                                                      # Clear color buffer with color


(rl-clear-screen-buffers)                                                     # Clear used screen buffers (color and depth)


(rl-check-errors)                                                             # Check and log OpenGL error codes


(rl-set-blend-mode mode)                                                      # Set blending mode


(rl-set-blend-factors gl-src-factor gl-dst-factor gl-equation)                # Set blending mode factor and equation (using OpenGL factors)


(rl-set-blend-factors-separate gl-src-rgb gl-dst-rgb gl-src-alpha gl-dst-alpha gl-eq-rgb gl-eq-alpha)  # Set blending mode factors and equations separately (using OpenGL factors)




# rlgl initialization functions


(rlgl-init width height)                                                      # Initialize rlgl (buffers, shaders, textures, states)


(rlgl-close)                                                                  # De-initialize rlgl (buffers, shaders, textures)


(rl-load-extensions)                                                          # excluded: raylib loads OpenGL extensions itself during init-window


(rl-get-version) → number                                                     # Get current OpenGL version


(rl-set-framebuffer-width width)                                              # Set current framebuffer width


(rl-get-framebuffer-width) → number                                           # Get default framebuffer width


(rl-set-framebuffer-height height)                                            # Set current framebuffer height


(rl-get-framebuffer-height) → number                                          # Get default framebuffer height


(rl-get-texture-id-default) → number                                          # Get default texture id


(rl-get-shader-id-default) → number                                           # Get default shader id


(rl-get-shader-locs-default) → [number ...]                                   # Get default shader locations




# Render batch management


(rl-load-render-batch num-buffers buffer-elements) → rlRenderBatch            # Load a render batch system


(rl-unload-render-batch batch)                                                # Unload render batch system


(rl-draw-render-batch batch)                                                  # Draw render batch data (Update->Draw->Reset)


(rl-set-render-batch-active batch)                                            # Set the active render batch for rlgl (NULL for default internal)


(rl-draw-render-batch-active)                                                 # Update and draw internal render batch


(rl-check-render-batch-limit v-count) → bool                                  # Check internal buffer overflow for a given number of vertex


(rl-set-texture id)                                                           # Set current texture for render batch and check buffers limits




# Vertex buffers management


(rl-load-vertex-array) → number                                               # Load vertex array (vao) if supported


(rl-load-vertex-buffer buffer dynamic) → number                               # Load a vertex buffer object


(rl-load-vertex-buffer-element buffer dynamic) → number                       # Load vertex buffer elements object


(rl-update-vertex-buffer buffer-id data offset)                               # Update vertex buffer object data on GPU buffer


(rl-update-vertex-buffer-elements id data offset)                             # Update vertex buffer elements data on GPU buffer


(rl-unload-vertex-array vao-id)                                               # Unload vertex array (vao)


(rl-unload-vertex-buffer vbo-id)                                              # Unload vertex buffer object


(rl-set-vertex-attribute index comp-size type normalized stride offset)       # Set vertex attribute data configuration


(rl-set-vertex-attribute-divisor index divisor)                               # Set vertex attribute data divisor


(rl-set-vertex-attribute-default loc-index value attrib-type count)           # Set vertex attribute default value, when attribute to provided


(rl-draw-vertex-array offset count)                                           # Draw vertex array (currently active vao)


(rl-draw-vertex-array-elements offset count buffer)                           # Draw vertex array elements


(rl-draw-vertex-array-instanced offset count instances)                       # Draw vertex array (currently active vao) with instancing


(rl-draw-vertex-array-elements-instanced offset count buffer instances)       # Draw vertex array elements with instancing




# Textures management


(rl-load-texture data width height format mipmap-count) → number              # Load texture data


(rl-load-texture-depth width height use-render-buffer) → number               # Load depth texture/renderbuffer (to be attached to fbo)


(rl-load-texture-cubemap data size format mipmap-count) → number              # Load texture cubemap data


(rl-update-texture id offset-x offset-y width height format data)             # Update texture with new data on GPU


(rl-get-gl-texture-formats format) → [number number number]                   # Get OpenGL internal formats


(rl-get-pixel-format-name format) → string                                    # Get name string for pixel format


(rl-unload-texture id)                                                        # Unload texture from GPU memory


(rl-gen-texture-mipmaps id width height format) → number                      # Generate mipmap data for selected texture


(rl-read-texture-pixels id width height format) → buffer                      # Read texture pixel data


(rl-read-screen-pixels width height) → buffer                                 # Read screen pixel data (color buffer)




# Framebuffer management (fbo)


(rl-load-framebuffer) → number                                                # Load an empty framebuffer


(rl-framebuffer-attach fbo-id tex-id attach-type tex-type mip-level)          # Attach texture/renderbuffer to a framebuffer


(rl-framebuffer-complete id) → bool                                           # Verify framebuffer is complete


(rl-unload-framebuffer id)                                                    # Delete framebuffer from GPU




# Shaders management


(rl-load-shader-code vs-code fs-code) → number                                # Load shader from code strings


(rl-compile-shader shader-code type) → number                                 # Compile custom shader and return shader id (type: RL_VERTEX_SHADER, RL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, RL_COMPUTE_SHADER)


(rl-load-shader-program v-shader-id f-shader-id) → number                     # Load custom shader program


(rl-unload-shader-program id)                                                 # Unload shader program


(rl-get-location-uniform shader-id uniform-name) → number                     # Get shader location uniform


(rl-get-location-attrib shader-id attrib-name) → number                       # Get shader location attribute


(rl-set-uniform loc-index value uniform-type count)                           # Set shader value uniform


(rl-set-uniform-matrix loc-index mat)                                         # Set shader value matrix


(rl-set-uniform-matrices loc-index mat)                                       # Set shader value matrices


(rl-set-uniform-sampler loc-index texture-id)                                 # Set shader value sampler


(rl-set-shader)                                                               # excluded: rlgl keeps the locs pointer after the call returns; use begin-shader-mode




# Compute shader management


(rl-load-compute-shader-program shader-id) → number                           # Load compute shader program


(rl-compute-shader-dispatch group-x group-y group-z)                          # Dispatch compute shader (equivalent to *draw* for graphics pipeline)




# Shader buffer storage object management (ssbo)


(rl-load-shader-buffer size data usage-hint) → number                         # Load shader storage buffer object (SSBO)


(rl-unload-shader-buffer ssbo-id)                                             # Unload shader storage buffer object (SSBO)


(rl-update-shader-buffer id data offset)                                      # Update SSBO buffer data


(rl-bind-shader-buffer id index)                                              # Bind SSBO buffer


(rl-read-shader-buffer id count offset) → buffer                              # Read SSBO buffer data (GPU->CPU)


(rl-copy-shader-buffer dest-id src-id dest-offset src-offset count)           # Copy SSBO data between buffers


(rl-get-shader-buffer-size id) → number                                       # Get SSBO buffer size




# Buffer management


(rl-bind-image-texture id index format readonly)                              # Bind image texture




# Matrix state management


(rl-get-matrix-modelview) → [16 numbers]                                      # Get internal modelview matrix


(rl-get-matrix-projection) → [16 numbers]                                     # Get internal projection matrix


(rl-get-matrix-transform) → [16 numbers]                                      # Get internal accumulated transform matrix


(rl-get-matrix-projection-stereo eye) → [16 numbers]                          # Get internal projection matrix for stereo render (selected eye)


(rl-get-matrix-view-offset-stereo eye) → [16 numbers]                         # Get internal view offset matrix for stereo render (selected eye)


(rl-set-matrix-projection proj)                                               # Set a custom projection matrix (replaces internal projection matrix)


(rl-set-matrix-modelview view)                                                # Set a custom modelview matrix (replaces internal modelview matrix)


(rl-set-matrix-projection-stereo right left)                                  # Set eyes projection matrices for stereo rendering


(rl-set-matrix-view-offset-stereo right left)                                 # Set eyes view offsets matrices for stereo rendering




# Quick and dirty cube/quad buffers load->draw->unload


(rl-load-draw-cube)                                                           # Load and draw a cube


(rl-load-draw-quad)                                                           # Load and draw a quad
